verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API and an HTTP API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. llms.txt is a documentation index, not an API spec, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
